## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Master Kàngcāng*

composed by [王士源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%A3%AB%E6%BA%90) (Wáng Shìyuán, 742); pseudepigraphically attributed to [庚桑楚](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BA%9A%E6%A1%91%E6%A5%9A) (Gēngsāng Chǔ)

A Táng pseudepigraphon attributed to the Warring-States figure **Gēngsāng Chǔ** 庚桑楚 (a disciple of Lǎo dān mentioned in the *Zhuāng zǐ*). Actually composed by Wáng Shìyuán 王士源 in 742 (Tiān bǎo 1), who acknowledges the fabrication in his preface. The text plays a double role in the Táng canon: it was one of the **four apocryphal Daoist classics** promoted by Táng Xuán zōng and studied for the *dào jǔ* 道舉 Daoist examinations. Catalogued in the Kanripo as a separate text from the matching Dào zàng entry [KR5c0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0050). Not preserved in the Kanseki mirror source tree (catalog entry only).

**Dating.** 742. Dynasty: 唐.
